bio.text: Juliana Stratton is the 48th Lieutenant Governor of Illinois and won the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in the March 17, 2026 primary.
Before her election as lieutenant governor in 2018, she represented the 5th District in the Illinois House of Representatives.
She was born and raised on the South Side of Chicago and is a graduate of the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and DePaul University's College of Law.
